info.name: Watch Management - Saga Pattern (DE190100)
info.description:
MSS301 Assignment 02 - automated Saga proof via API Gateway. Run folders 00 -> 08 in order. Designed to work unchanged both locally and after Docker because baseUrl remains http://localhost:8080.

FIXED AUTH: protected requests use request-level Bearer Auth. Token variables are wmAdminToken/wmStaffToken to avoid collisions with variables from other Postman environments/projects.

V2 VARIABLE ISOLATION: all collection variables are wm-prefixed (for example wmBaseUrl, wmToday, wmAdminToken) so active Postman environments from other projects cannot override generic variable names such as baseUrl/today/token.

exec: pm.test("401 access token is not refresh token", () => pm.response.to.have.status(401));
pm.test("401 refresh token as bearer", () => pm.response.to.have.status(401));
pm.test("403 spoofed role is stripped", () => pm.response.to.have.status(403));
pm.test("401 spoofed role without token", () => pm.response.to.have.status(401));
